items.name: 檸檬千層
items.description: 新鮮檸檬的清新酸香與香滑卡士達完美融合，層層薄餅皮帶來豐富的口感層次，酸甜平衡的滋味清爽不膩，是夏日裡最令人心曠神怡的選擇。
items.description_en: Fresh lemon's zesty aroma perfectly blends with smooth custard cream. Multiple layers of delicate crepe create rich textural complexity. The balanced sweet and tangy flavor is refreshing and never cloying, making it the perfect choice for any season.

items.name: 焦糖千層
items.description: 濃郁的焦糖香氣與柔滑奶油交織出溫暖的甜蜜滋味，層層薄餅皮帶來豐富的口感體驗，焦糖的焦香與奶香的完美平衡，是令人回味無窮的經典口味。
items.description_en: Rich caramel aroma interweaves with smooth cream to create a warm, sweet delight. Layers of delicate crepe offer a rich textural experience. The perfect balance between caramel's toasty notes and creamy sweetness makes this a classic, unforgettable flavor.

items.name: 藍莓千層（測試）
items.description: 選用優質藍莓製成的千層蛋糕，藍莓的酸甜與香滑卡士達完美結合，層層疊疊的薄餅皮帶來豐富的口感層次，每一口都能感受到藍莓的天然果香。
items.description_en: Made with premium blueberries, the sweet and tangy flavor of blueberries perfectly combines with smooth custard cream. Layers of delicate crepe create rich textural complexity, and every bite offers the natural fruity aroma of blueberries.

items.name: 香草千層
items.description: 經典香草口味的千層蛋糕，選用天然香草豆製成的香滑奶油，層層薄餅皮與香草奶油的完美融合，帶來純粹而優雅的味覺享受，是永遠不會出錯的經典選擇。
items.description_en: A classic vanilla mille crepe made with natural vanilla beans. Smooth vanilla cream perfectly blends with layers of delicate crepe, offering a pure and elegant taste experience. A timeless classic that never fails to delight.

items.name: 伯爵茶千層
items.description: 採用頂級伯爵茶葉製成的千層蛋糕，伯爵茶特有的佛手柑香氣與香滑奶油完美融合，層層薄餅皮帶來豐富的口感，茶香淡雅不搶味，是茶香愛好者的理想選擇。
items.description_en: Made with premium Earl Grey tea leaves, the distinctive bergamot aroma of Earl Grey perfectly blends with smooth cream. Layers of delicate crepe create rich texture, while the elegant tea flavor never overpowers, making it ideal for tea lovers.

items.name: 提拉米蘇千層
items.description: 將經典義大利提拉米蘇風味融入千層蛋糕中，咖啡的香醇與馬斯卡彭起司的濃郁完美結合，層層薄餅皮帶來豐富的口感層次，微苦微甜的味道令人回味無窮。
items.description_en: The classic Italian Tiramisu flavor reimagined as a mille crepe. Rich coffee notes perfectly blend with the creaminess of mascarpone cheese. Layers of delicate crepe create rich textural complexity, while the balanced bitter-sweet flavor is unforgettable.

items.name: 紅茶千層
items.description: 選用優質紅茶葉製成的千層蛋糕，紅茶的溫潤茶香與香滑奶油完美融合，層層薄餅皮帶來豐富的口感體驗，茶香淡雅清新，是下午茶時光的完美搭配。
items.description_en: Made with premium black tea leaves, the warm, aromatic tea notes perfectly blend with smooth cream. Layers of delicate crepe create a rich textural experience. The elegant and refreshing tea flavor makes it the perfect accompaniment for afternoon tea.

items.name: 咖啡千層
items.description: 採用優質咖啡豆製成的千層蛋糕，濃郁的咖啡香氣與香滑奶油完美結合，層層薄餅皮帶來豐富的口感層次，咖啡的微苦與甜味平衡，是咖啡愛好者不容錯過的選擇。
items.description_en: Made with premium coffee beans, the rich coffee aroma perfectly blends with smooth cream. Layers of delicate crepe create rich textural complexity. The balanced bitter-sweet coffee flavor makes this a must-try for coffee enthusiasts.
